item.title: Euphorbia neriifolia L. extract protects against cardiomyocyte injury and heart failure
item.description: Announcing a new publication for Acta Materia Medica journal. Heart failure (HF) remains a major global health challenge with limited therapeutic options, thus prompting the search for novel cardioprotective agents among traditional Chinese medicines.

item.title: Infant screen time linked to slower cognitive processing and teen anxiety
item.description: Children exposed to high levels of screen time before age two showed changes in brain development that were linked to slower decision-making and increased anxiety by their teenage years, according to new research by Asst Prof Tan Ai Peng and her team from A*STAR Institute for Human Development and Potential (A*STAR IHDP) and National University of Singapore (NUS) Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, using data from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) cohort.

item.title: Dihydrotanshinone I induces autophagic cell death in ovarian cancer
item.description: A recent study published in Engineering has shed light on the potential therapeutic effects of dihydrotanshinone I (DHT), a compound derived from the traditional Chinese herb Salvia miltiorrhiza, on ovarian cancer.

item.title: Epigenetic clocks accurately predict age from human skeletal muscle
item.description: A new research paper was published in Volume 17, Issue 11 of Aging-US on November 26, 2025, titled "Epigenetic aging signatures and age prediction in human skeletal muscle."

item.title: Targeting CSE enzyme may offer new pathways for Alzheimer’s treatment
item.description: Scientists at Johns Hopkins Medicine say results of a new National Institutes of Health-funded study are advancing efforts to exploit a new target for Alzheimer's disease: a protein that manufactures an important gas in the brain.

item.title: Silica nanomatrix enhances immunotherapy for solid tumors
item.description: Cancer has long remained a leading cause of death worldwide and in Hong Kong, accounting for 30% of all disease-related deaths in the city in 2025. While chemotherapy remains a major treatment modality, its side effects and the risk of relapse challenges for patients.

item.title: Private equity firms increasingly dominate fertility clinics in the United States
item.description: The rise of private equity firms investing in health care facilities across the United States has been exploding in the last decade.

item.title: New computational method reconstructs how cells decide their fate
item.description: Researchers from Kyushu University have developed an innovative computational method, called ddHodge, that can reconstruct the complex dynamics of how cells decide their fate.

item.title: Study sheds new light on the role of NSUN2 protein in cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure
item.description: A recent study published in Engineering has shed new light on the role of the protein NSUN2 in the development of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure.

item.title: Novel method can generate functional organoids from human adult adipose tissue
item.description: A recent study published in Engineering has unveiled a novel approach to generating functional organoids from human adult adipose tissue.
